props.heading: A Cleaner Fuel For a Greener Tomorrow
props.html:
Biodiesel is a renewable, clean-burning diesel alternative produced through the trans-esterification of non-edible vegetable oils. As a mono alkyl ester, it is chemically similar to conventional High-Speed Diesel (HSD) but produces 86% fewer greenhouse gas emissions.

At Kotyark Industries, we manufacture premium B100 biodiesel that can be blended at any ratio — from B5 (5%) to B100 (neat) — delivering superior lubricity, higher cetane numbers, more power, and better mileage than conventional diesel.

Our biodiesel is approved by the Bio-Fuel Authority under the Rural Development Department and Panchayati Raj, Government of Rajasthan, ensuring the highest standards of quality and environmental compliance.

props.heading: About Kotyark Industries
props.subheading: Pioneering India's clean energy revolution through biodiesel manufacturing since our foundation.

props.heading: Building India's Biofuel Future
props.html:
Kotyark Industries Limited is a publicly listed biodiesel manufacturing company on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE). We operate state-of-the-art, zero-discharge biodiesel production facilities in Sirohi, Rajasthan and Anand, Gujarat.

With an annual installed capacity of 480,000 kiloliters and daily production of 210 KL, Kotyark is one of India's leading biodiesel manufacturers. We convert non-edible vegetable oils into premium B100 biodiesel through advanced trans-esterification processes.

Our operations are approved by the Bio-Fuel Authority under the Rural Development Department and Panchayati Raj, Government of Rajasthan, reflecting our commitment to quality, safety, and environmental responsibility.

items.title: Our Vision
items.body: To be India's most trusted producer of sustainable biofuels, leading the nation's transition to carbon-neutral energy and reducing dependency on imported fossil fuels.

items.title: Our Mission
items.body: To manufacture premium-quality biodiesel that exceeds industry standards while maintaining zero-discharge operations, supporting rural employment, and delivering value to our shareholders and communities.

props.heading: Biodiesel (B100)
props.subheading: Premium renewable diesel fuel — cleaner burning, carbon neutral, and superior performance.

props.heading: What is B100 Biodiesel?
props.html:
Biodiesel is a renewable, clean-burning diesel replacement produced through the trans-esterification of non-edible vegetable oils. Chemically classified as a mono alkyl ester, biodiesel is functionally equivalent to petroleum-based High-Speed Diesel (HSD) but with dramatically lower environmental impact.

At Kotyark Industries, we manufacture B100 (neat/pure) biodiesel at our Government-approved, zero-discharge facilities. B100 can be used directly or blended with petroleum diesel at varying ratios — from B5 (5% biodiesel) to B20 (20% biodiesel) — without requiring engine modifications.

Our biodiesel meets all quality standards set by the Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) and is approved by the Bio-Fuel Authority under the Government of Rajasthan.
props.imageAlt: Biodiesel production cycle showing feedstocks, biofuel production, renewable fuel, and CO2 absorption

props.heading: Benefits of Biodiesel
props.html:
Biodiesel delivers measurable advantages across environmental, economic, and operational dimensions.

  • 86% less greenhouse gas emissions compared to petroleum diesel
  • Higher cetane number for improved combustion and engine performance
  • Superior lubricity that protects fuel system components and reduces wear
  • More power and better mileage than conventional HSD diesel
  • Carbon neutral — CO₂ absorbed during biomass growth offsets emissions
  • Non-toxic and biodegradable — environmentally safe in case of spills
  • Reduces India's dependency on imported crude oil
  • Creates rural employment through feedstock cultivation and processing

props.heading: Biodiesel Applications
props.intro: B100 biodiesel and its blends serve diverse sectors across India's economy.

items.title: Transport & Logistics
items.body: Commercial fleets, trucks, and heavy vehicles. B5–B20 blends require no engine modifications and provide cleaner emissions.

items.title: Industrial Power
items.body: Backup power generators, boilers, and industrial heating systems. Biodiesel provides reliable, cleaner-burning energy.

items.title: Agriculture
items.body: Farm equipment, tractors, and irrigation pump sets. Biodiesel supports rural India's energy needs sustainably.

props.heading: Crude Glycerin
props.subheading: Premium by-product of biodiesel manufacturing — versatile applications across industries.

props.heading: What is Crude Glycerin?
props.html:
Crude glycerin (also known as glycerol) is a valuable by-product generated during the trans-esterification process of biodiesel manufacturing. For every 10 parts of biodiesel produced, approximately 1 part of crude glycerin is obtained.

At Kotyark Industries, our crude glycerin is produced alongside our premium B100 biodiesel at our zero-discharge facilities. The glycerin undergoes quality checks to ensure it meets industry standards for various downstream applications.

Crude glycerin serves as a versatile raw material across multiple industries — from food processing and pharmaceuticals to cosmetics, soaps, and industrial chemicals. After refinement, it becomes a high-value ingredient in thousands of consumer and industrial products.

props.heading: Crude Glycerin Uses
props.intro: Our crude glycerin finds applications across diverse industries after appropriate processing and refinement.

items.title: Food Processing
items.body: Used as a humectant, sweetener, and solvent in food products. Refined glycerin is GRAS (Generally Recognized As Safe) approved.

items.title: Pharmaceuticals
items.body: Essential ingredient in syrups, cough medicines, capsules, and topical formulations for its moisturizing and solvent properties.

items.title: Cosmetics & Personal Care
items.body: Key ingredient in skincare, haircare, and personal hygiene products for its moisturizing, emollient, and humectant properties.

items.title: Soap & Detergents
items.body: Traditional and modern soap manufacturing uses glycerin as a base ingredient, providing moisturizing properties to the finished product.

items.title: Industrial Chemicals
items.body: Used as a raw material in producing alkyd resins, polyurethanes, and various industrial chemicals and solvents.

items.title: Animal Feed
items.body: Crude glycerin is used as an energy supplement in livestock and poultry feed formulations, adding caloric value.
